todos: [P2] QWEN38-FULLTASK-01: Live full-task results of 2026-09-26 after the audit. qwen3-coder:30b run audit-20260926c: VERIFIED, 8/8 milestones, 37/50 steps, about 53 min, median prompt eval 5.0 s and median step 21 s (qwen3.8 on 2026-09-25: 57.9 s and 128 s); installs approved, build fixed after 3 failures (snapshot %USERPROFILE%\OnlyRag-Live\snapshots\*audit-20260926c*). Run audit-20260926b (before the stall fix) closed on transport_budget: Ollama sends nothing while a tool call is generated and a 1193-token write at 3.95 tok/s hit the fixed 5-minute stall limit twice (now speed-based). qwen3.8:27b: run audit-20260926 was stopped by the assistant at step 5 to fix the transcript; step 1-2 telemetry showed num_ctx 65536, 83% CPU / 17% GPU, a full 37 s prompt re-evaluation at step 2 and 1092 thinking tokens at about 2.85 tok/s (6.4 min per turn with the model's default 'medium' thinking). A direct probe (%USERPROFILE%\OnlyRag-Live\audit\cacheprobe-20260926.mjs) showed qwen3.8 does reuse its cache both when appending and when replacing the trailing message (4.4 s / 6.8 s vs 40.9 s cold), so the step-2 miss is still unexplained: suspect the rendering of the assistant thinking in history (think omitted = model default). Run audit-20260926b with the append-only transcript was stopped at the user's request before any telemetry. Next: rerun qwen3.8 with a unique ONLYRAG_LIVE_RUN, check per-turn promptEvalDurationMs from step 2 on; if misses persist, compare with modelThinkingPreferences['qwen3.8:27b']='low' or false and with thinking stripped from history. Workspaces fulltask_qwen3-coder-30b-audit-20260926, -audit-20260926b, -audit-20260926c and fulltask_qwen3-8-27b-audit-20260926, -audit-20260926b are disposable after their snapshots (cleanup tracked in LIVE-QWEN-WORKSPACE-CLEANUP-01).

[P2] AGENT-AUDIT-20260926-RESIDUALS-01: Of the residuals the coding-agent audit of 2026-09-26 left (docs/coding-agent-audit-2026-09-26.md), these were closed on 2026-09-26 with unit tests: PersistentPowerShellSession reports its real working directory and structuredCommandSafety resolves relative paths there, following cd within one command too; npx of a command missing from node_modules/.bin (and pnpm/yarn dlx, bunx) counts as network use; replace_file_content and multi_replace_file_content return the applied diff and the incremental typecheck like write_file; git_commit allows 120 s for pre-commit hooks; git_diff lists untracked files; web_search, fetch_web_content, open_in_browser and validate_visual_artifact approvals use the new 'network_request' card type; validate_visual_artifact reports a page that did not load separately from a missing Playwright runtime. On 2026-09-26 the incremental typecheck after TypeScript edits moved to a worker thread (dist-electron/typecheckWorker.js, WorkspaceTypecheckWorkerClient, verified from app.asar under Electron). Still open: no background-process tool or port probe for dev servers, so a blocked server still ends as a refused command.

[P2] AGENT-DIRECTIVE-AUTHORITY-02: The audit of 2026-09-26 made planDirectiveArbiter policy-aware, filtered policy-refused tools from the catalogue and turned the version-behind and milestone-redelivery orders into notes, but other tool-result producers still end with 'Directives: MUST' blocks (compilerDiagnosticDirective, testFailureDiagnostic, moduleResolutionDiagnostic, npmVersionNotFound, npmResolutionConflict, installVersionDowngrade, redundantWriteDetector, loopDetector interventions). Convert them to facts the arbiter consumes, add an invariant test that no two orders can reach one turn, and review the guards that never fired in 67 live snapshots for removal. This rewrites text the model reads on failure turns, so it needs a live full-task run to confirm no regression; it was left for a session where live runs are possible.

[P2] CODING-HISTORY-RESET-01: The original backup at %USERPROFILE%\OnlyRag-Backups\coding-agent-20260925-170040 has 58 valid SHA-256 copies; five source files in .onlyrag_v2\sessions are already absent. The qwen3.8 run added two history files, copied and hash-verified in coding-agent-20260925-qwen38-extra. Thus 55 session/state/tracker files remain, including 32 in the retired workspaces. The user explicitly authorized reset on 2026-09-25, but automatic execution review rejected the exact targeted Remove-Item -LiteralPath -Force operation as blocked by policy. No history file was removed. When policy permits, recheck hashes and paths, remove only verified history files, preserve code, documents, snapshots, backups and live workspaces, then verify the app starts with empty history.

[P3] LEGACY-MIGRATIONS-01: One-time migrations from earlier layouts are still executed on every launch or read, while this is a single-user install and CODING-HISTORY-RESET-01 will empty the history anyway. Renderer: AppLayout.tsx imports localStorage onlyrag_app_settings, onlyrag_initial_setup_completed and onlyrag_language when settings.json is missing; useSessionHistory and useWorkspaceProjects push localStorage data through sessions:migrate-legacy and projects:migrate-legacy (ipcContract, secureIpcMain schemas, sessionHistoryIpc, projectRegistryIpc, SessionHistoryAppService, ProjectRegistryAppService, projectRegistryDomain merge). Main: appSettingsRepository.decodeSettingsFile accepts unversioned settings and rewrites maxToolCallSteps>=200; agentSessionStateRepository moves .onlyrag/.agent_state_*.json and .assistant/SESSION_TRACKER.md; sessionHistoryRepository moves .onlyrag/session_history.json; sidecarProcessManager migrates legacy nested data entries; restoreFileVersionEvidence accepts the pre per-file { filePath, contentHash }; plan code still recognises legacy synthetic finish milestones (agentOrchestratorApplicationClosure.ts, planAndSolveGraph.ts, agentTaskContract.ts defaults). The scripts/e2e/settingsBootstrap.mjs cases cover the localStorage path. After the history reset, confirm the local stores are on the current layout, then remove each migration with its IPC channel, tests and E2E cases, keeping the settings.json version check.

[P3] I18N-MAIN-MESSAGES-01: agent:log carries structured localized keys (shared/domain/agent/agentMainText.ts, English in src/i18n/locales/en.ts agentMain) with the Italian text as logMessage fallback. On 2026-09-26 every tool result producer was migrated through the toolLog helper of toolExecutionContracts.ts (filesystem, web, Git, recovery, process preconditions, ensure_tool, policy and visual validation), and the fixed-language orchestrator emitLog lines (final verification, workspace error, preflight, execution guard, skill router/hub, plan seeding, session timeout). Deliberately left as they are: 'Task Finished:' and the AI Agent Question marker (parsed by agentLogMessageUtils/AgentTimelineMessage), the bracket markers kept inside the localized texts ([SECURITY BLOCK] etc., used for categories) and diagnosticsToolService's 'Agent Question:'. Remaining: sessionDebtTracker markdown (SESSION_TRACKER.md is fed back to the model, so changing it needs a live run), and the Sidecar chunk prefix [Documento: ... | Sezione: ...] (requires a re-index migration).

[P3] SIDECAR-OPENCV-DUPLICATE-01: rapidocr (like rapidocr-onnxruntime before it) requires opencv-python, while requirements.txt pins opencv-python-headless; both 5.0.0.93 are installed into the same cv2 package directory, and PyInstaller collects both. Uninstalling either breaks cv2, and the bundle carries the GUI build too. Pick one: drop opencv-python-headless (sidecar/infrastructure/ocr.py imports cv2 for preprocessing, which either build serves) or install rapidocr with --no-deps plus its listed dependencies; then rerun the Sidecar tests and the PyInstaller build.

[P3] HOME-STORE-LEFTOVERS-01: Since 2026-09-26 no store writes to %USERPROFILE%\.onlyrag_v2: the capability-policy audit and the session fallbacks use userData (userdata_dev headless). The folder still holds the obsolete logs\capability_policy_audit.json (139,129 bytes, test decisions) and sessions\session_history.json (empty history written by the tests); both are unused and the user can delete the folder. scripts/clean_workspace.ps1 still lists it for cleanup. Standalone scratch (resolveStandaloneScratchBasePath) still falls back to that folder when neither Electron nor a custom path is available; no test takes that path today.

[P3] CI-PYTHON313-01: .github/workflows/ci.yml now pins python-version '3.13.15' (matching .python-version); the workflow has not run since the 2026-09-26 migration, so actions/setup-python availability of that exact patch and the pip cache were not observed. Check the first CI run after the push; if 3.13.15 is not in the setup-python manifest, pin the nearest listed 3.13.x in both files.
